name: io.github.itmarkerz/calcbloc-mcp
title: CalcBloc tax and salary calculator
description: Take-home pay, employer cost and official tax tables for 24 countries, with sources.

environmentVariables.name: CALCBLOC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional; needed after 50 requests/day. Free key from https://calcbloc.com/developers/keys (5,000 requests/day).

environmentVariables.name: CALCBLOC_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional folder with the CalcBloc tax-table data (https://calcbloc.com/data) for offline tax tables.
